limits: Enum includes units/type inconsistencies; e.g. U16 with negative input ranges. Preserve source claims until actual encode/decode branch verified.
Period gain_hint2 is not a divisor2. App uses raw/50 seconds at nominal50Hz or raw/60 at60Hz; B253 extended-time flag can override.
Embedded defaults are not live inverter values and are not included.

extended_times.validity: bit0 of firstU16 is set AND firstU16 != FFFF
extended_times.target: All FFFF in observed target reply; period fallback applies

public_record_redaction: Private LAN addresses, MACs and serial identifiers are pseudonymized. Encoded identity bytes may be substituted, so affected historical frames are not checksum-valid replay fixtures. Private captures and WLAN credentials are excluded.
